title: Ticket, please. / What will you do?
subtitle: 请把车票拿出来 / 你将做什么？

lead.question: 赶火车还有大把时间，你会不会顺路去喝一杯？如果车站的钟慢了十分钟，会发生什么？
lead.warmup: 先别看课文。想象车站售票窗口：你要买两张去伦敦的往返票，先问下一班车几点开（What time will the next train leave?），再问在哪个站台（Which platform?）。乔治和肯一看表：才 7 点 57 分，8 点 19 分才开车——时间还很宽裕嘛！于是去车站旁的酒吧喝了杯东西。可回到车站时，收票员一句 You've just missed it!（你们刚好错过了！）让他们傻眼。问题出在哪？听听最后那个叫人哭笑不得的回答：In five hours' time!
goals: 能用 What time will the next train leave? / Which platform? 询问车次与站台
掌握 plenty of（充足的，可接可数或不可数名词）与 have a drink, next door to 等短语
掌握 had better（最好）表建议及其否定 had better not
会用 in five hours' time / in an hour's time 表「……时间以后」
lead.summary: 第 95 课车站喜剧：乔治买好两张 8 点 19 分去伦敦的火车票（2 号站台，过天桥）。肯以为时间宽裕，拉乔治去隔壁酒吧喝一杯；乔治提醒「我们最好现在回车站」，但为时已晚——收票员说他们刚好误了车。车站的钟慢了十分钟，下一班车要在五个小时以后！第 96 课操练 had better 句型和 in ...'s time 将来时间表达。
lead.tips: ① had better + 动词原形表示「最好……」的忠告，说现在或将来，不说过去；否定是 had better not do，口语缩写 'd better；② must 语气比 had better 强，是「必须」；③ plenty of 后面可数、不可数名词都可以：plenty of time / plenty of eggs；④ 钟表快慢用 fast/slow：That clock's ten minutes slow.（那钟慢了十分钟）；⑤ in five hours' time 表示「五小时以后」，注意 hours 的所有格 's；⑥ porter 这里指车站上验票、搬行李的搬运工/收票员。

questions.q: Why did George and Ken miss the train?
questions.zh: 乔治和肯为什么误了火车？
questions.a: Because they went to have a drink in a bar next door to the station, and the station clock was ten minutes slow.
questions.aZh: 因为他们去车站隔壁的酒吧喝酒了，而车站的钟慢了十分钟。
questions.hint: 结合 Let's go and have a drink 和 That clock's ten minutes slow。

questions.q: What time will the next train leave, and which platform is it?
questions.zh: 下一班火车几点开？在哪个站台？
questions.a: At nineteen minutes past eight (8:19). Platform Two, over the bridge.
questions.aZh: 8 点 19 分开车，2 号站台，过天桥。

questions.q: What do George and Ken want to catch?
questions.hint: We want to catch ... 那句。

questions.q: When's the next train after that?
questions.zh: 再下一班车是什么时候？
questions.hint: 对话最后一句，只有三个词。

questions.q: Who is to blame for missing the train — the slow clock, Ken's drink, or something else?
questions.zh: 误了火车该怪谁——慢十分钟的车钟、肯的那杯酒，还是别的？
questions.a: Open answer. The clock misled them, but Ken's 'plenty of time' attitude and the drink made them late; George's 'We had better go back' came too late. 参考答案：慢钟误导了他们，但「时间还很宽裕」的松懈心态和那杯酒才是主因；等乔治说「最好回车站」已经来不及了。
questions.aZh: 慢钟有责任，但主要是他们太松懈：明明 George 已提醒最好回车站，还是去喝了那杯酒。
questions.hint: It's only three minutes to eight 时谁提议去喝酒？

questions.q: You had better stay here. / We had better wait for him.
questions.zh: 第 96 课操练：had better + 动词原形表「最好……」。
questions.a: You had better call a doctor. / They had better go home.
questions.aZh: 你最好去请医生。/ 他们最好回家。
questions.hint: had better 后接动词原形，不定式符号 to 不出现。

drill.q: You/We/They had better ___. / I'll go to ___ in ___'s time.
drill.zh: 你（我们/他们）最好……。/ 我将在……（时间）以后去……。（had better 表建议；in ...'s time 表「……以后」）

answers: You had better call a doctor.

We had better to go back to the station now.
We have better go back to the station now.
We had better going back to the station now.
quiz.note: had better + 动词原形，中间不加 to，也不用 -ing。

quiz.q: had better 的否定形式是：

quiz.q: We've got plenty of time. 中 plenty of 表示：

复数 hours 的所有格是 hours'。

grammar.title: had better 表建议
grammar.structure: had better (not) + 动词原形；口语缩写 'd better
grammar.definition: had better 表示「最好还是……」，表达忠告或建议，语气比 must 温和。它表示现在或将来，而不表示过去；否定形式是 had better not + 动词原形。
grammar.usage: 催促、提醒对方及时做某事。

examples.en: We had better go back to the station now, Ken.
examples.zh: 肯，我们现在最好回车站去。

examples.en: You had better hurry.
examples.zh: 你最好赶快。

grammar.title: had better 与 must 的语气比较
grammar.structure: had better do（建议）< must do（必须）
grammar.definition: must 表示「必须、一定」，是说话人强加的义务，语气强烈；had better 只是劝告「最好这样做」，不做也可以，只是后果可能不妙。
grammar.usage: We must hurry if we want to catch the last train.（想赶上车就必须快）

examples.en: We must hurry if we want to catch the last train.
examples.zh: 如果想赶上末班车我们就必须快点。

examples.en: You had better be careful.
examples.zh: 你最好小心一点。

grammar.title: in ...'s time 表将来
grammar.definition: in five hours' time / in an hour's time / in two days' time 表示「……（时间）以后」，与一般将来时连用。注意复数所有格：five hours' time。
grammar.usage: 回答 When's the next train? / When will you ...?

examples.en: In five hours' time!
examples.zh: 五个小时以后！

examples.en: I'll go to Sydney in a month's time.
examples.zh: 一个月以后我去悉尼。
